name: fence-omitted-is-chief-only-not-unfenced
description: OMITTING launchIntentPersonIds is an empty allow-list, never an off switch - the highest-ranked fail-safe in the plan. It denies every non-root person and leaves the root running, and those are two different mechanisms rather than one: the fence ADMITS the root (LaunchFence::admits short-circuits on the root head) and the root separately holds an unconditional organization-root lease, which is what actually keeps it desired. Admission and demand are different facts.
